suggestions.reason: The without-skill agent solved this in 7 tool calls / 49s — essentially as fast as a with-skill agent would. This pilot-eval-1 may not discriminate between with/without skill conditions because the affordance descriptor is so self-documenting that cold discovery is nearly free. Consider an eval where the affordance is intentionally missing, or where multi-term AND or paging across >100 hits is required, to stress what the skill specifically adds.
